name: bottom-tab-bar
title: Bottom Tab Bar
description: The phone version of App Rail: equal-width icon tabs along the bottom of the screen with an orange top bar on the active tab.
usage: Map
notes: Tabs are at least 48px tall and pad the bottom for the home indicator with env(safe-area-inset-bottom); add viewport-fit=cover to your viewport meta for that to apply. Keep it to five tabs and put the rest behind a More tab.
The bar does not position itself. Fix it to the bottom, or make it the last row of a full-height flex column as the App Shell block does, and leave room for it under the page content.
